basis.name: I1
basis.definition: I1 = sum_{mu<nu} eta^mu eta^nu <F_mu nu, F_mu nu>_eta, <F,G>_eta = tr(eta F eta G^T), F_mu nu = A_mu eta A_nu - A_nu eta A_mu; = (1/2) F_{mu nu a b} F^{mu nu a b}

basis.name: I2
basis.definition: I2 = F_{mu nu a b} F^{a b mu nu} (derivative pair of one F contracted with the internal pair of the other; mixed pairs use delta)

basis.name: I3
basis.definition: I3 = F_{mu nu a b} F^{mu a nu b} (eta on the mu-mu and b-b pairs, delta on the mixed nu-a pairs)

basis.name: I4
basis.definition: I4 = R_{nu a} R^{nu a} = sum eta_nu eta_a R[nu,a]^2, R[nu,a] = sum_mu F[mu nu a mu]

basis.name: I5
basis.definition: I5 = R_{nu a} R^{a nu} = sum_{nu a} R[nu,a] R[a,nu], R[nu,a] = sum_mu F[mu nu a mu]

basis.name: I6
basis.definition: I6 = R^2, R = sum_nu R[nu,nu] = sum_{mu nu} F[mu nu nu mu]

basis.name: E1
basis.definition: E1 = F[pqrs] F[xyxy] eps[pqrs] (eps[F1.d0,F1.d1,F1.i2,F1.i3] (F2.d0-F2.i2) (F2.d1-F2.i3); slots 0,1 derivative, 2,3 internal; one Levi-Civita symbol; the R0 rule extended: eps-d eta, eps-i delta)

basis.name: E2
basis.definition: E2 = F[pqrx] F[syxy] eps[pqrs] (eps[F1.d0,F1.d1,F1.i2,F2.d0] (F1.i3-F2.i2) (F2.d1-F2.i3); slots 0,1 derivative, 2,3 internal; one Levi-Civita symbol; the R0 rule extended: eps-d eta, eps-i delta)

basis.name: E3
basis.definition: E3 = F[pqrx] F[xysy] eps[pqrs] (eps[F1.d0,F1.d1,F1.i2,F2.i2] (F1.i3-F2.d0) (F2.d1-F2.i3); slots 0,1 derivative, 2,3 internal; one Levi-Civita symbol; the R0 rule extended: eps-d eta, eps-i delta)

basis.name: I1_h
basis.definition: I1_h = sum_{mu<nu} eta^mu eta^nu tr(h_cov F h_cov F^T), h_cov = eta + 2 (eta u)(eta u)^T, u = timelike unit eigenvector of M eta (contravariant, u^T eta u = -1); = I1_frob in the vacuum eigenframe

basis.name: J1
basis.definition: J1 = sum_{mu<nu} eta^mu eta^nu tr(F eta M eta F eta M eta) (contravariant F, M joined by eta; tr((FM)^2)-type)

basis.name: J2
basis.definition: J2 = sum_{mu<nu} eta^mu eta^nu tr(F eta F eta M eta M eta) (tr(F^2 M^2)-type)

basis.name: Pgrad
basis.definition: Pgrad = sum_mu eta^{mu mu} q(d_mu P_t, d_mu P_t), P_t = u u^T eta, q(X,Y) = sum_ab eta_a eta_b X[a,b] Y[a,b], d_mu u by first-order eigenvector perturbation of M eta along A_mu (the search knob -kappa is the coefficient)

basis.name: K_T
basis.definition: K_T (R7): (1/2) sum_mu eta^mumu [tr(h A_mu h A_mu) - tr(eta A_mu eta A_mu)], h = h_cov

basis.name: T1
basis.definition: eta^{mu nu} tr(A_mu eta A_nu eta)

basis.name: T2
basis.definition: eta^{mu nu} tr(A_mu eta) tr(A_nu eta)

basis.name: T3
basis.definition: div_b eta^{bd} div_d, div^b = sum_mu (A_mu)^{mu b}

basis.name: T4
basis.definition: sum_{mu nu} (A_mu)^{mu nu} tr(A_nu eta)

basis.name: K_lambda
basis.definition: K_lambda: E = (1/2) sum_a [sum_i (d_i lambda_a)^2 + omega^2 (d_t lambda_a)^2], lambda_a eigenvalues of N = M eta, d_mu lambda_a = (v_a^T eta A_mu eta v_a)/(v_a^T eta v_a)

basis.name: R_etaMeta
basis.definition: R_G with G = etaMeta: sum_mu nu G_cd [(A_mu)^(nu c)(A_nu)^(mu d) - (A_mu)^(mu c)(A_nu)^(nu d)], mixed pairs by delta, G covariant (0,2); E-density = c_R R_G

basis.name: R_hcov
basis.definition: R_G with G = hcov: sum_mu nu G_cd [(A_mu)^(nu c)(A_nu)^(mu d) - (A_mu)^(mu c)(A_nu)^(nu d)], mixed pairs by delta, G covariant (0,2); E-density = c_R R_G

basis.name: K_P_h
basis.definition: K_P^h (H-adjoint form, the author's 2026-09-05 correction): E = (1/2)[sum_i tr(Om_i H Om_i^T H^-1) + omega^2 tr(Om_0 H Om_0^T H^-1)], Om_mu = P A_mu eta P, H = eta + 2 (eta u)(eta u)^T; = the Frobenius norm of the projected jet in the eta-orthonormal eigenbasis (PSD everywhere)

basis.name: Q_I1sq
basis.definition: (F.F)^2 = I1^2 (class C5)

basis.name: C6a
basis.definition: [sum_mu eta^mumu tr(d_mu M eta d^mu M eta)]^2 (C6)

basis.name: C6b
basis.definition: sum_{mu nu} eta^mumu eta^nunu [tr(d_mu M eta d_nu M eta)]^2 (C6)
